critical_code_review_comments: Sticky hierarchy is correct: controls bar at top:0 (z-30) → misal toggle at top-14/56px (z-20) → column header at top-[100px] (z-10). This stacking order is intentional and correct.

overflow-clip (not overflow-hidden) is correctly used on MisalSection outer div — this is key because overflow:hidden would prevent sticky children from working, while overflow:clip allows stickiness to propagate through.
The 100px = 56px (sticky controls h-14) + 44px (misal toggle py-3 + content) is a reasonable approximation for the column header sticky position.
Layout.jsx main element overflow:auto is confirmed as the scroll container — sticky elements in CollectionSheet.jsx correctly reference this scroll ancestor.
